card.name: Verbs after subject in Russian space text
card.fires_on: Passive or linking verbs and small words (chosen, taken, as, become, took, will) in a clause about Russian or space-research topics, just before the role or action is stated.

modes.label: Participle before role
modes.description: Words like chosen, taken or 'as' that introduce what something is treated as or used for.
modes.example: the planet was<< chosen>> as a promising target for further studies.

modes.label: Verb or helper in the clause
modes.description: Helper or main verbs such as become, took, will, us in sentences on Russian space policy or history.
modes.example: the study of exoplanets has<< become>> more intensive and competitive than ever.

card.plain: It fires on connecting verbs in articles about Russian space research, right before the purpose or result is given.
